name: Indian Symbology
description: This course explores the diverse and layered symbolic systems embedded in Indian visual and material culture. It examines indigenous and classical symbols with religious, mythological, and folk origins and their implications for contemporary design practices. Students will learn to critically interpret, analyze, and apply Indian symbolic systems to contemporary communication and interaction design practices.
